normalization.refs: compare opaque canonical refs exactly after private-runtime canonicalization; never infer refs from display names
normalization.channels: lowercase canonical transport class, e.g. email, messaging, calendar
normalization.tags: exact opaque tags; no stemming, synonym expansion or embedding similarity
normalization.patterns: match canonical field value only; never match raw message content

tokens.*: zero or more characters except ':' or '/'
tokens.**: zero or more characters including ':' and '/'

evaluation.selector_match: normal selectors match only when every declared exact/pattern/tag clause resolves true
evaluation.value_semantics: values within one exact/pattern clause are OR; separate clauses are AND
evaluation.fallback: fallback selector matches only when no non-fallback selector matched for the same resolution layer branch
evaluation.base_unselected: a base policy with no selector is universal and always participates
evaluation.all_matches_compose: every matching non-fallback policy in a layer/branch participates in merge; there is no winner-takes-all selector
evaluation.no_suppression: an exact match does not suppress a matching pattern or tag policy; therefore a broad deny remains effective
evaluation.person_resource: person and each resource branch are matched independently before subject-parallel intersection
evaluation.channel: channel policies are matched after subject resolution but may also constrain person/resource/adapter fields

authority_effect: deny/lock/grant algebra from policy-inheritance resolves authority
fallback participates only if the branch has zero non-fallback matches
specificity_tuple: selector_id lexical ascending as trace-only final tie breaker
precedence.security_note: specificity ordering is descriptive/trace ordering only; it never discards another matched policy.

branches.base: one base branch; universal selectorless base policies always participate; matched selected bases also participate
branches.person: one branch for resolved person ref
branches.resource: one independent branch per resolved resource ref; branches intersect
branches.channel: one branch for the current canonical channel
